spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact shipped surface from web_transport.idl ('responseHeaders' in WebTransport.prototype, RuntimeEnabled=WebTransportHeaders) and demonstrates why the request-side headers option is undetectable by construction (silent unknown-member drop) with a real throwaway construction.

interactive.rationale: Re-probe button re-runs all four cells including the real construction.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the only-trustworthy-signal framing; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes WebTransport-absent, attribute-absent-but-constructor-accepts (the trap, amber), and full support.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5194104408506368 plus both spec anchors and the IDL.

conformance.rationale: Suite asserts baseline, the prototype attribute, the never-throws trap as its own contract, null-before-establishment, and keeps the server round trip manual.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: baseline function, responseHeaders false, constructor honestly accepted the ignored option; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: Emerald/amber/rose verdicts on paper (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Native button; status aria-live; labelled cells.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Grid collapses under 640px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.detail: With --enable-blink-features=WebTransportHeaders the prototype cell should flip true and the verdict to detectable-and-present.
